title: The Procession of Unlit Candles
description: At the autumn festival, the candles step out of their brass holders and climb the maple road to watch the sun rise.
alt: Tall ivory candles with black wicks and spindly wax legs climb a winding path through red maples at sunrise. Two people carry empty brass holders.
pairing: An imagined autumn festival × candles that walk on wax stilts
